verdict.overall: The big story since Sunday is a broad pullback: TSLA, PLTR, NVDA, AMAT and AVGO are all down 10-18%, dragging floors and ceilings sharply lower even as most option setups stayed neutral rather than turning hostile. APP is the outlier, up 56% but now flagged opposing across every expiry, a warning against chasing that move. GOOGL looks calmest with fair-to-cheap pricing, while ZETA, AMAT, NVDA and BE carry extra caution from earnings or pricey options; overall confidence in clean range trades is lower given the widespread slide toward support floors.
